title: H203: Risk-parity blend of H026+BAB+MOM+TOM — test as production portfolio
rationale: We now have 4 confirmed strategies with different beta profiles: H026 ETF rotation (beta ~0.5, Sharpe ~1.2), H191 BAB (beta ~0, Sharpe 1.367), H198 momentum (beta ~0.6, Sharpe 1.174), H201 TOM (beta ~0.75, Sharpe 0.740). The natural next step is to blend them using risk parity (Riskfolio-Lib HRP/NCO) and test whether the combination beats any individual strategy on OOS Sharpe and MaxDD. This is H203. Use monthly rebalance, Ledoit-Wolf covariance, 24-month lookback for weights.
content:
